name: 21713 · Boonsboro, MD
findings: ZIP 21713 (Boonsboro) has 55 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (37% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 21713 (Boonsboro) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
